room_rent.note: Room rent capped at Single Private Room for SI 5L and 10L

icu.note: ICU charges covered up to Sum Insured; no separate ICU cap stated

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay for insured persons aged 61 years and above at time of first policy issuance; waivable via optional Mandatory Co-pay Waiver add-on

sub_limits.display: Cataract: 10% of SI max ₹75K/eye; LASIK: ₹30K both eyes
sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at 10% of SI max ₹75,000 per eye; LASIK capped at ₹30,000 for both eyes; Bariatric Surgery capped at 50% of SI max ₹5 Lakh

deductible.note: No inbuilt deductible; optional voluntary deductible of ₹10K/25K/50K available

ped_waiting.note: Optional ABCD PED cover (Asthma, BP, Cholesterol, Diabetes) waives PED wait to 30 days for those conditions

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for cataract, hernia, BPH, hydrocele, etc.; 36-month wait for rheumatoid arthritis, joint replacement, LASIK, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: CB increases 50% per claim-free year up to 100% of SI; reduces at same rate on claim. Optional CB Booster add-on can extend to 500% or 1000%

restoration.note: Triggered on second claim in policy year; available for same or new illness; excludes CB; available once per policy year

pre_hosp.note: Schedule shows 60/90 days for 5L-10L band; 60 days is the lower/base option

post_hosp.note: Schedule shows 90/120 days for 5L-10L band; 90 days is the lower/base option

domiciliary.display: Covered (Home Health Care up to 20% of SI)
domiciliary.note: Home Health Care covered up to 20% of SI via empanelled provider on cashless basis only

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to Sum Insured; preventive/rejuvenation and OPD excluded

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses covered; donor screening, pre/post-hosp for donor excluded

ambulance.note: Emergency road ambulance ₹1,500 per hospitalisation for 5L-10L plans

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, etc. covered up to SI

consumables.display: Optional add-on (up to 15% of admissible claim)
consumables.note: Consumables/Non-Medical Expenses Cover available as optional add-on; covers List I items up to 15% of admissible claim

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only; treatment outside India is a specific exclusion

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, external congenital anomaly, STDs (non-HIV), stem cell storage, hormone replacement therapy, infertility complications, dental (unless injury-related)
optional_riders: Voluntary Deductible, Consumables Cover, CB Booster (500%/1000%), Critical Illness Booster, PED ABCD Cover, Accident Care (AD/PTD/PPD), Mandatory Co-pay Waiver
